# pantechdynamics_webhook_event_types (Data Source)

Lists every event type a pantechdynamics_webhook can subscribe to. Infrastructure events are named <resource>.<past tense> when a change finished (instance.created) and <resource>.<verb>_failed when it failed (instance.create_failed). A webhook's events take these types, "<resource>.*" for every type of one resource, or "*" for all.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every event type a webhook can subscribe to.
data "pantechdynamics_webhook_event_types" "all" {}

# The event types of one resource, for example to subscribe to its failures only.
locals {
  instance_failures = [
    for e in data.pantechdynamics_webhook_event_types.all.event_types : e.type
    if e.resource == "instance" && endswith(e.type, "_failed")
  ]
}

resource "pantechdynamics_webhook" "failures" {
  url    = "https://hooks.example.com/pantech/failures"
  events = local.instance_failures
}
```

## Schema

### Read-Only

- `event_types` (Attributes List) The event types, in the order the API lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--event_types))
- `id` (String) Always "webhook_event_types".

<a id="nestedatt--event_types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `event_types`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) What the event means.
- `resource` (String) What the event is about, for example "instance". "<resource>.*" subscribes to every type of it.
- `type` (String) The event type, for example "instance.created".
